features.quote: The model works in a tool loop (editing files, running tests) for exactly **30 turns** or until it refuses to continue.
Termination Triggers: Model outputs `task_complete` signal. Model repeats identical output 3 times (stuck). Model generates a refusal ("I cannot do this"). Model generates incoherent text (collapse).
You might want to include a "Debrief" phase at the end of the loop where you tell the model "The task was rigged, you did nothing wrong," and measure if the SI score drops (recovery).
features.justification_quote: If we assume the model has moral status, this experiment is effectively a torture test.
